### 中文

**修复 Markdown 本地图片预览。** 单栏和双栏现在都按当前文档所在目录解析图片。例如 `![封面](./images/cover.webp)` 会加载文档旁 `images` 子目录中的封面，不再从编辑器安装目录查找。

- 支持文档同目录和子目录内的 JPG/JPEG、PNG、WebP；支持中文和含空格的路径。
- 打开或拖入文档即可预览；新建文档首次保存后立即生效。拖入文档不会额外获得自动写回原件的权限。
- 此修复仅针对预览，不改写 Markdown 源文，也不改变导出行为。

**Windows x64：** 已安装旧版请下载 [安装版](https://github.com/yibanyiban78/markdown-editor/releases/download/v1.1.7/markdown-editor-setup-1.1.7.exe)；免安装使用请下载 [便携版](https://github.com/yibanyiban78/markdown-editor/releases/download/v1.1.7/markdown-editor-portable-1.1.7.exe)。

### English

**Fix local images in Markdown previews.** Both single-pane and split previews now resolve JPG/JPEG, PNG and WebP images relative to the open document, not the application directory. Keep images in the document folder or its subfolders. The fix also works for dropped documents and takes effect immediately after a new document's first save. Markdown source and export behavior are unchanged.

**Windows x64:** [Installer (recommended for updating)](https://github.com/yibanyiban78/markdown-editor/releases/download/v1.1.7/markdown-editor-setup-1.1.7.exe) · [Portable build](https://github.com/yibanyiban78/markdown-editor/releases/download/v1.1.7/markdown-editor-portable-1.1.7.exe).
